headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.

headlines.title: Price of parenting: the household maths giving China’s consumers pause
headlines.summary:
Qiu Huiying, a human resources manager in Guangdong, worries in numerical terms when she looks ahead to the next decade: a 20-year mortgage, a 10 per cent loss on her property and thousands of yuan in monthly childcare costs that are set to rise.
She bought a 624 sq ft flat last year, so her mother-in-law could move in and help care for her son. But the purchase now feels less prudent after prices in the 20-year-old complex have already fallen by about 10 per cent.

headlines.summary: 从国家电投集团获悉，电投绿能3750吨“氢洲·绿氨”当天从连云港离岸起航发往韩国，创下全球最大单批次绿氨出口纪录，这也是中国绿色燃料首次凭借全生命周期碳减排贡献，获得国际市场绿色价值认可。本次出口的绿氨产品全部产自国家电投“氢洲·大安绿氨”示范项目。作为国家清洁低碳氢能示范工程、战略性新兴产业“百大工程”，该项目2025年7月建成投产，配套新能源装机80万千瓦，可年产绿氢3.2万吨、绿氨18万吨。

headlines.title_en: UK 2/10-year Treasury yield falls about 5 bps
headlines.summary_en: On Tuesday (July 28), at European market close, the UK 10-year government bond yield fell 4.8 basis points to 4.949%, in a downtrend throughout the day, trading in the range of 4.976%-4.945%, with a sharp short-term drop after 23:00 Beijing time, approaching the daily low set at 16:48. The 2-year UK bond yield fell 5.3 basis points to 4.328%. The 30-year UK bond yield fell 3.2 basis points, and the 50-year UK bond yield fell 3.1 basis points. The 2/10-year UK bond yield spread rose 0.384 basis points to +61.725 basis points.

headlines.title_en: State Power Investment Corporation completes world's largest single batch of green ammonia export
headlines.summary_en: Learned from State Power Investment Corporation (SPIC), 3,750 tons of 'Hydrogen Continent·Green Ammonia' from Dian Tou Lv Neng set sail from Lianyungang to South Korea on the same day, setting a global record for the largest single batch of green ammonia exports. This marks the first time China's green fuel has gained international market recognition for its green value due to its full life-cycle carbon emission reduction contribution. The green ammonia exported this time is all produced from SPIC's 'Hydrogen Continent·Da'an Green Ammonia' demonstration project. As a national clean low-carbon hydrogen energy demonstration project and a strategic emerging industry 'Top 100 Project,' the project was completed and put into operation in July 2025, supporting 800,000 kilowatts of new energy installed capacity, capable of producing 32,000 tons of green hydrogen and 180,000 tons of green ammonia annually.
